race.description: RMBL Investments Rising Stars Race Hcp (Bm56)
race.comment: MANCHEGO (5) has been in the frame at all four runs this time in work, the latest a narrow defeat over 1212m at Kilmore. Placed twice to this trip so the small step up in distance holds no fears. Strong weight carrier who is the testing material with a couple of key rivals coming out. FRENCH NAVY (3) returned from a 41-week spell with a tough win in a BM56 over 1200m at Hamilton recently. Should hold that form and with a bit of luck from a tricky gate can play a key role in the outcome. QUEEN OF THE SURF (9) has placed at two of three first-up runs so keep her in mind coming off an 18-week spell. Best figure in the past 12 months is the benchmark in this field. FENESTELLA (8) was shuffled back before the corner then stoked up late to finish third when resuming over 1235m at Geelong recently. This doesn't look as tough so she is one of the key runners. Last start Mortlake maiden winner BACK UP BARBIE (6) faces a tougher task today but is lightly raced and still a work in progress.
